description: This PHP class 'EmployeeLanguage' extends 'FilterField' and implements 'ValueXNormalizable' to facilitate filtering employee language data within reports. It interacts with the LanguageService to retrieve language details and constructs query conditions based on operator and filter value.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguage
classes.description: A filter field class used to filter employees based on their language skill for reporting purposes.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a filtering condition to the query builder based on the employee's language if the operator is EQUAL and a value is set.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns aliases used for entity joins in the query, here 'language'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Normalizes the filter value into an array containing language id and name, retrieved via LanguageService.
